Hogs are a variety of pigs that appear as bosses in Donkey Kong Jungle Beat. They are all kings of the various kingdoms that Donkey Kong must face throughout his adventure. They can generate electric orbs from their hands, blast out shock-waves of electricity, and teleport all over the place. To beat them, Donkey Kong must send the fruit they send out, back at them, by punching it back. This will stun them for a while and decrease their health. Then, he must jump on the Hog and punch it many times. There are four Hogs in the game: Rogue-Hog, Mo-Hog, Bloat-Hog, and Gloat-Hog. Waldo C. Graphic is a computer-generated puppet character, who appears in the attraction Muppet*Vision 3D and also appeared in the TV series The Jim Henson Hour. He is noted for being the first computer-generated Muppet and probably the first digital puppet created by any company. The character of Waldo is best described as a cross between a bug and a seal, with random elements of either thrown in. He flies and hovers in his scenes. His first name is a reference to a "Waldo"—a device used by puppeteers to remotely control a puppet. His middle initial likely stands for "Computer", as in "Waldo Computer Graphic". The Great Spirits are characters who make the magical changes in Disney's 2003 animated feature film Brother Bear. They have the spirit of Sitka transform his younger brother Kenai into a bear as a punishment for killing an innocent bear that didn't kill Sitka, and Nita into a bear in the 2006 sequel because she wanted to marry Kenai instead of Atka.
Thackery Binx is one of the tritagonists in Hocus Pocus. He was transformed into an immortal black cat in the beginning of the film. During it, he finds himself growing attached to Dani Dennison.

Hector Felipé Corrio, alias Skate Lad, is the other male member of Teamo Supremo. He is a young Mexican kid who lives with his unnamed mom and dad (who runs the sporting goods store) and his two infant sisters known only as "The Twins". He was recruited to the team due to his superb skateboarding skills. Prior to his recruitment, he had been the state's skateboarding champion for three years running and was up for a new challenge. As Skate Lad, he uses a special jet-propelled skateboard to outrun his opponents. At times, Hector can be a little stubborn. Tibor and Lumia are the Izzet League champions on Ravnica. They are a husband and wife team of archmages. Tibor is a master of wind magic and most commonly uses his talents for magical flight. Lumia is a master of earth magic and can call magma to the surface to scorch enemies on the ground. Tibor is wise, noble, head in the clouds in contrast to his wife's fiery and wild-eyed abandon. Tibor died during the War of the Spark.

Kathril, Aspect Warper is a legendary nightmare insect from the plane of Ikoria. Kathril, a cunning insectile nightmare with powerful shapeshifting abilities, lurks in the peaty marshes of Indatha. It uses the shifting, adaptive tendrils on its body to mimic other creatures and delights in deceiving would-be predators. Many a monster hunter, seeing only a big bug, has ventured after what he thought was easy prey, only to meet his end at Kathril's mandibles: the planeswalker Vivien Reid hopes that many more will. Whether hunter or hunted, Kathril chooses when it is seen.

Kalcooms are capable of shrugging off attacks from other creatures while they are flying, something which Castor compared to his observations of a United Nations Space Command UH-144 Falcon in flight during Operation: JOVIAN WHISTLE.

Shadows are Seiðr Reavers who use deadly magic. They are projectile-based enemies that prefer to attack from afar or on high areas. Shadows have low health, so usually a couple of arrows from Atreus, or a toss of the Leviathan Axe is enough to put them down. However, they can move around quickly by teleporting to safety, before attacking. They are first encountered during the battle between Kratos and a group of hungry cannibalistic Reavers in the Jötnar Marketplace.

The expeditious messenger resembles a cross between a winged lemur and a diminutive dragon. This homunculus is one of the few that can pass as an organic creature, though it is crafted from clay, hair, scales, and feathers. The expeditious messenger is only 9 inches from its nose to its barbed tail. This homunculus is designed for one purpose: to quickly ferry messages to and from its creator. It is designed to move fast, and will avoid combat at all costs to continue to ferry its message.

If someone makes fun of its appearance or manages to put it at a disadvantage during battle, Xingtianmon will become enraged and let out a war cry while wildly brandishing the axe in its right hand. It loves learning about Digimon species and ecology, and telling people what it has learned most of all. Attacks *Terrier Tornado (Petit Twister): Generates a tiny tornado by spinning its ears like a propeller. *Dai Bacchi Gū: Enlarges the badge on its chest and hurls it.

Onibimon is a Ghost Digimon. It assumes the form of a small spirit. As its appearance suggests, it is able to slip through tangible surfaces. In Shambala, Onibimon are believed to be Digimon that lived to the end of their natural lives, reincarnated by passing through the world of Yomi. Attacks *: Spews pale blue sparks of fire from its mouth.

It can move these arms freely, using them to fire lasers or grab hold of its enemy. The two eye-like devices at the base of its wings also grant it excellent detection capabilities, allowing it to find Digimon hidden in the shadows or underground. That is because it accepted and contained its power within its body. It still hasn't awakened to that power, but if it grows up the right way, it can be said that its qualities for maturing into a true guardian of the Digital World will have improved. Since its instincts as a Virus-species have also increased, its personality has become more aggressive. It is surely a frightening Digimon, as when it judges an intruding Digimon to be an opponent, it will repel them with all the attacks it is able to muster, and if it is driven into a predicament, it will completely annihilate the intruder by blowing itself up. Ghilliedhumon is an incredibly adept hunter, and its camouflage-covered body allows it to blend in with the forest and strike without giving its position away to its prey. Though Ghilliedhumon has a peaceful disposition, it is very territorial over its hunting grounds, and those who carelessly wander into its domain will be sniped without warning. Knights are a class of the Hive species. Knights provide support to Acolytes in battle, often wielding massive Cleavers or Boomers, or rarely, Shredders. They can also summon a Wall of Darkness, an impenetrable shield of pitch-black energy, in front of them. The Wall of Darkness regenerates a small portion of their health and protects them from frontal damage, but renders them immobile.

Takul-Dar, the Unbreakable was an Elite Hive Knight with the ability to undo their own death that appeared in the Deathless Adventure on Titan. During the repair of the Rig, many of Sloane's crew had problems with the Knight, and as a result, she sent in the Guardian to deal with them. Despite their shielding and self-resurrection ability, Takul-Dar was eventually slain by the Lightbearer for good.

Orm Vashyx is a Major Taken Knight who is encountered near the end of The Oracle Engine Mission. They are tasked with blocking the entrance to the tower, and serve as the second to last line of defense for the Engine, before Mukor and Ugroth, until they are slain by the Guardian. However, they are brought back every three weeks with the curse on the Dreaming City, preventing them from truly dying.

It can be found in the Burmecia suburbs as well as the grasslands and beach areas on the Mist Continent overworld near to the Chocobo's Forest, and on the daylight grassland areas on the Alexandrian lowlands. It has a nasty breath attack, Flame, that hits the entire party hard (for its level). Quina can eat it to obtain the Blue Magic, Angel's Snack. Urvan Veleth is a Dunmer vampire and a boss encountered in Spindleclutch II. He fights alongside two Boneman Archers and two Boneman Warriors. He will periodically transform into a red pool, following a player while being immune to damage.

The Hound, formerly known as Ulthorn, is a Bosmer follower of Hircine and leader of the Houndsmen. He is the primary antagonist of the Malabal Tor questline. He is also allies with the Wood Orc clans of Dra'bul and Jathsogur, and is responsible for most of the chaos shrouding the region. When speaking to his associates, he chooses to project himself in the form of a spectral wolf.

Mistmen are floating, legless skeletons in that can be found in the Soul Cairn. They may be summoned with the Conjure Mistman spell tome, which can be found in the Soul Cairn. Conjured Mistmen may pick up weapons dropped by killed enemies. They typically fight by hurling frost spells.
Durnehviir (Dragon Language: Dur–Neh–Viir, "Curse–Never–Dying") is an undead Dragon residing in the Soul Cairn, where he guards Valerica under orders from the Ideal Masters.

Dad of Quincy is a non-playable character who is the father of Quincy. He was a wise mentor of the BTD6 Heroes back when these Heroes were kids. Unfortunately, since the setting of the modern age of Bloons TD 6, he has passed away and became a ghost. He is available as Heroes Pets Trophy Store item as the Dad of Quincy Pet, introduced in Version 19.0. He costs 75 to unlock. He is only available on normal Quincy. Upon placement of Quincy, Dad of Quincy's ghostly head floats above the ground. Regularly, he moans and croaking laughs. Occasionally, he floats around the screen towards nearby space, regardless of terrain.
Asperii, also known as wind steeds, were magical horses that possessed keen minds and telepathic powers and the ability to fly.

An air elemental (sometimes called a wind elemental) was an elemental being made up of wind and living air. It appeared as a shapeless cloud that moved rapidly in any direction, even against the wind.

The bronze dragonflight is a draconic organization primarily led by the eponymous bronze dragons to uphold their creed to the world. The titan Aman'Thul blessed the wise Nozdormu and his brood with the ability to time travel and mastery of temporal magic. Generally stoic and detached from 'current' events, they are rare to interact with mortals unless they require help in safeguarding the one true timeline. Their nemeses are the Infinite dragonflight, a faction of bronze dragons corrupted by the Old Gods who wish to rewrite the timeline. Altairus is an immense storm dragon and the second boss of the Vortex Pinnacle.

Sersi is a Marvel Comics character that appears as the protagonist in Eternals. She is portrayed by Gemma Chan. She is a member of an alien race called the Eternals. After several centuries of non-interference, she has to use her powers to protect Earth from the Deviants and decided to stop the emergence of a Celestial. She has superhuman strength, enhanced durability, and the ability to use cosmic energy to transmute matter. Sersi was created by Stan Lee, Jack Kirby, George Klein, Mike Sekowsky and Werner Roth.

In addition, it carries a very potent toxin, and it is dangerous to even touch it. The Witch Mother is a character featured in the 2022 Disney+ original film Hocus Pocus 2. She is portrayed by Hannah Waddingham. The Witch Mother is a powerful witch, with the ability to transform into a bird, and resides in Salem. She was the one to gift the Sanderson Sisters their sacred spellbook and introduce them to witchcraft.

Yokomon is a Bulb Digimon. It is a Lesser Digimon with a large flower blooming from its head. It is able to move by skillfully operating its root-like tentacles, and with its lightness, it can rise into the air, but only to a small height. As it is brimming with curiosity, it is restlessly stirring and its appearance seems very cute. It has a habit of living together in flocks, and it is said that due to grouping, the flocks will grow from a few to a few hundred. It has small feathers growing closely packed on its body, and unusually for an In-Training Digimon, it has wings. Its most charming feature is the feather ornament attached to its head, so it maintains it intently. It has a fundamentally tidy personality, but because it cannot turn its neck(?) even if it wants to groom itself, it relies on its comrades. In addition, even if the wielder had no psionic potential, the artifact links directly to the wielder, allowing them to use psionic powers from the artifact itself. The dark templar guardian Lassatar was tasked with retrieving this artifact on the terran colony world of Roxara. He could not locate it, but a terran child named Tiffy guided him to the relic. Eight Sword Style is the fighting style of Hyouzou. He wields eight swords at once, one in each hand and one in each of his six tentacles. He is able to coat the swords in his blue-ring octopus venom to kill opponents with his attacks. After overdosing on Energy Steroids, he became powerful enough to cut through iron.

Luong Lao Shi (龍老師) also known as Gramps, is a main character of American Dragon: Jake Long. He is Jake's maternal grandfather, trainer, and official Dragon Master, and was formerly the Chinese Dragon as a young man.

Rasielmon is a Throne Digimon. Rasielmon was once appointed to the same rank as Ophanimon. It possesses the mysterious power to foresee everything in the world from the "Kernel" (God's domain). It is said that it knows all about events throughout the Digital World, and has gained a divine amount of knowledge with that power. Anshal is a mighty djinn that commands the winds of the West. Anshal and the rest of the Conclave survived their defeat in the Throne of the Four Winds. They initially supported Prince Sarsarun to succeed Al'Akir, but were ultimately convinced of Thunderaan's power.

Ancalagon, also known as Anddraca, the Great Dragon of Morgoth, the Black Dragon, or the Black, was the "greatest of the winged dragons of Morgoth" and "mightiest of the dragon-host" during the War of Wrath. He was bred by Morgoth during the First Age and possibly was the largest winged dragon to have ever existed in Middle-earth.

The Witch-king of Angmar was the chief of the Nazgûl, King of Angmar and Sauron's great captain in his wars. A wraith, the Witch-king of Angmar was nearly indestructible, a terrifying warrior, and a cunning strategist.
Temari generates a huge wind cyclone that emits from her Giant Folding Fan, then swings the fan to make a sweep with the cyclone, levelling a large area around her.

While in Sage Mode, Naruto creates two shadow clones, one that tackles the opponent to the ground, and the other to help him form the Rasengan. After forming the Rasengan, Naruto jumps at the opponent with it.

Hashirama Senju creates a dense growth of trees, controlling how it grows using his chakra. The trees' life force is immense enough to split the earth as they sprout and further pierce through any other obstructions they encounter. This growth is also fast enough that it can capture targets before they have a chance to escape. Hashirama used this technique to serve as a foundation for Konohagakure; none other than Hashirama have been capable of such a feat.

Dashiell Robert "Dash" Parr is a major character in the 2004 Disney•Pixar animated film The Incredibles and its 2018 sequel. He is the middle child and eldest son of Bob and Helen and is the younger brother to Violet and older brother to Jack-Jack. As an offspring of Supers, he has the ability to run super fast, allowing him to run on water as well as other physics-bending maneuvers such as running up buildings.

Kolaghan (/koʊlʌɡɑːn/ KOH-luh-gahn) is one of the five elder dragons of Tarkir. She is titanic, covered in spines, features four feathered wings, and is able to breathe lightning. Feral and brutal, she enjoys the hunt and the kill more than the resulting meal. Unlike the other dragons, Kolaghan does not appear to speak draconic, only communicating in lightning flashes and violence.

Rouge the Bat, commonly known as simply Rouge, is a major character from the series, appearing since her game debut in Sonic Adventure 2. She is an anthropomorphic white bat whose wings enable her to fly. Rouge carries a lot of experience in treasure hunting, mainly focusing on the Master Emerald and Chaos Emeralds. In the Super Mario franchise, Rouge regularly appears in the Mario & Sonic series, usually as a rival or one of the playable athletes.

Pata Mario is an original transformation that appears in Super Mario-kun and successor to the Saint Wing Mario from Super Mario Brothers 2. Attained by taking the wings from a Koopa Paratroopa, it allows Mario to fly. Super Mario Party Jamboree later depicts characters equipping a pair of wings similar to those of a Paratroopa for the same purpose, though it is not clear whether these are genuine Paratroopa wings or replicas.
